git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
Add coverage for what a post page actually renders

CI only ever checked the home page's links and the one 404 case; nothing
opened a real post and looked at the result. Doing that surfaced two bugs:

- resolveTranslation's default-locale fallback only tried an exact locale
  match, so a post whose default locale (e.g. "ja-JP") only had a
  language-tagged translation ("ja") 404'd for any visitor whose accepted
  locales didn't also match. Fixed by trying a language match too, same as
  the accepted-locale passes.
- The home page linked to every post regardless of whether it had a
  translation, so a post with an empty translations list (draft-notes) was a
  dead link. Fixed by only listing posts resolveTranslation can render for
  some visitor.

Added unit tests for resolve-translation's fallback order and e2e tests that
navigate to real posts under different accept-languages and assert on the
rendered heading, plus a home-page test that an untranslated post isn't
linked.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"
